plain: Whether stated confidence matches how often one is actually right, whether the speaker is a judge model or an assistant answering a question.
eli5: When the weather person says 70% rain, it should rain on about 7 of 10 such days.
technical: Agreement between predicted probabilities and observed frequencies (reliability diagrams, expected calibration error); Claude's constitution lists being calibrated (confidence that matches the evidence, admitting uncertainty) among its honesty properties. On the LLM-judges map also: aligning human raters to the policy on a shared calibration set.
